PHYSICS — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn.

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

4. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental ? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic waves ● Production, properties, detection and applications of el.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

13. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Diodes 4.0 Environmental and Space Physics 4.1 Physics of wind formation 4.2 Int? (1 mark)
